brief:
Eye on Palestine reported on an elderly Palestinian woman's vow to remain on her property despite its destruction. The woman declared repeatedly, "My land is Palestine. I will not leave, I will not leave," expressing her refusal to depart in the face of home demolition.

Her statement underscores a posture of steadfastness adopted by Palestinians confronting displacement and property loss in occupied territories. The woman's defiant words, captured amid the ruins of her residence, encapsulate the resolve of residents determined to maintain their claim to land despite authorities' demolition efforts and pressures to relocate.
